# ClearedToCode Downloads

The one place every finished ClearedToCode app is published. The website,
Discord and anyone else link here, so there is a single copy of each file to
keep up to date.

Products, serials and support: <https://clearedtocode.com> ·
Discord: <https://discord.gg/qzaeDtCxK>

Every version of an app, with its checksums and older installers, is on that
app's page. Always check a download against its `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## How this repository is organised

```
apps/<app-id>/app.json     name, summary, platform of one app (edit by hand)
apps/<app-id>/README.md    that app's page; the version table is generated
catalog.json               every app and release, for the website (generated)
scripts/build-catalog.mjs  regenerates catalog.json and the tables
PUBLISHING.md              how to release a new version or add an app
```

The installers themselves live in [Releases](https://github.com/tekkid2024/clearedtocode-downloads/releases),
one release per app version, tagged `<app-id>-v<version>` (for example
`vantage-v1.0.8`). Publishing a release updates `catalog.json` and the tables
here automatically.

## For the website

Read the catalog from

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tekkid2024/clearedtocode-downloads/main/catalog.json
```

`apps[].latest.assets[].url` is the direct download link for the newest
version of each app; `apps[].releases` has every version, newest first.
